scope: Syntax and local CLI/path boundaries only; not a product, schema-suite, CI, registry or publication validation.
checks: syntax compiles without executing publication main
all original non-main functions are AST-identical
entire publication main from report construction onward is byte-identical
helper has no hardcoded private absolute paths
help exits without inspecting source or contacting network
both explicit path options are required
temporary fixture has a candidate different from HEAD
subdirectory is rejected instead of silently changing checkout
invalid source arguments do not create report directory
report directory creation does not create missing ancestors
valid explicit candidate is retained instead of substituting HEAD
explicit paths with spaces are resolved correctly
one final report directory component is created
no network or publication main was called
